text:
mia (Marketing): Quick heads-up — we’re targeting a public release for Orbit v1.4 tomorrow 10:00am PT. Need final changelog link, stable docs URL, and a 1-line benchmark headline for the webinar slide. Can eng confirm canary + full rollout times? @raj @olivia :tada:

raj (Eng Release): Canary at 08:00 PT, ramp to prod by 09:30 PT. Final changelog PR will be ready by 07:30 PT and I’ll paste the link here. Feature flags: `orbit_v1_4`, `orbit-bypass-cache`. No DB migration. :white_check_mark:

olivia (Docs): Docs will be stable on staging by 07:45 PT — staging link: https://docs-staging.redwood.ai/orbit/1.4. I’m still updating the diagrams, will publish canonical /docs/orbit/1.4 at ~08:00 PT if all good. If marketing needs a canonical URL now, use staging and I’ll swap the redirect when live. :eyes:

tom (Product): For the webinar narrative we need the benchmark blurb by EOD today. One sentence + a stat is ideal.

maya (Marketing Ops): Also need a 2-bullet changelog excerpt we can drop into the post/meta description. Can someone paste 2 tight bullets here?

raj (Eng Release): Changelog excerpt (draft):
- Reduced decode p95 by ~22% on A10064 through improved KV cache handling.
- Added routing fallback to maintain availability when zonal capacity is low.
PR: https://github.com/redwood-inference/orbit/pull/472 :sparkles:

deploy-bot: Scheduled canary deploy at 2026-03-23T08:00:00-07:00 for orbit_v1_4 (job #8673) — https://deploys.redwood.ai/jobs/8673 :rocket:

jess (Eng QA): We’ll run smoke tests at +15m and +45m after canary. Test vector set: `v1.4-smoke` (internal link). If any regression, we’ll roll back and post results here.

sam (Eng Oncall): Oncall watching. If rollback needed we’ll revert to orbit_v1_3 and pause rollout.

raj (Eng Release): quick perf snippet you can use in the blog/test slide: 
```
curl -H \"Authorization: Bearer $TOKEN\" https://api.redwood.ai/v1/infer -d '{"model":"orbit-1.4","input":"hello"}'
```
Bench expectation: p95 ~180ms on A10064 (internal micro-bench, non-prod). Use as illustrative only.

mia (Marketing): Timeline for marketing: blog post 10:00am PT, social 10:15am, webinar 11:00am PT. We need the final PR/changelog by 08:00 PT to cut the copy. Olivia — can you add the short "how this affects customers" paragraph by 08:30 so we can finalize messaging?

olivia (Docs): Yup — I’ll add a short customer impact paragraph and a usage example to staging by 08:20.

maya (Marketing Ops): Perfect. One more ask — can we get a PNG of the benchmark graph (wide, 1200x600) by 09:00 so design can drop it into the slides?

raj (Eng Release): I’ll export a graph and drop it to the release PR by 08:45.

mia (Marketing): Thanks all. I’ll prep copy with the two bullets and the staging docs link for now. Will update the post when the canonical docs URL lands. Tag me if anything changes. :pray:
